metadata.description: RAF-batched paint channel. View FormulaCels declare metadata.channel: ["dom.paint"]; the cascade buffers their render-specs here, and draining forwards them to the per-state painter which coalesces into one rAF flush.
Channel drain: forwards each buffered view cel's render-spec to the painter's batched enqueue.
Pure vnode diff: (prev, next) → JSON Patch. Positional children by default; keyed reconciliation when both lists are fully keyed.
DOM-mutating patch applier (browser only): (target, mounted, patch, reg, state, doc) → new mounted node. Maintains the per-element listener registry.
Global-listener reconciliation: diff prev vs next listener-spec arrays and add/remove on the named global targets.

metadata.name: dom
metadata.description: (tag, ...children) - a presentation vnode value. tag.class is emmet sugar; string children → text, nested dom(…) → elements, (style …)/(attr …)/(on …) → that element's style/attributes/events.

metadata.name: style
metadata.description: (prop value …) - inline styles for a dom element; pass as a child of dom().

metadata.name: attr
metadata.description: (name value …) - HTML attributes (href, target, type, id, …); pass as a child of dom().

metadata.name: on
metadata.description: (event handlerKey [payload]) - bind a dom event to a handler cel; pass as a child of dom(). =dom("button", on("click", "wallet.lock"), "lock"). The handler runs (state, payload, event).
